text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's――while most of the world takes time off,
it wouldn't be an exaggeration to call this the busiest time of year for a hot spring town.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the Yukoma Ryokan was no exception.
Thinking it would just be a casual way to pass the New Year's holiday, I offered to lend a hand, but...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Once you're finished with that, could you please
help welcome the guests~?
We seem to be short-handed over there...!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, landlady.
I look forward to your hospitality again this year.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Happy New Year.
We have been eagerly awaiting your arrival.
Please, relax and make yourself at home――
choice_data_list: Allow me to hold your luggage...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Customer
text_block_list.text:
Um~ excuse me,
I'd like to check in...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Yukoma Hot Springs Resort.
You must be the guest booked under the name 'Haabibagokuraku', correct?
We have been expecting you.
choice_data_list: (Customers are pouring in one after another...!)

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that looks like the end of the welcoming rush
for the time being~.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But don't let your guard down.
The real rush starts right now.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: You brace yourself too, you hear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I might have just stepped right into an utter disaster zone...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I'll carry this one,
so could you grab that beer crate over there?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"For the guests in the Mist Room,
serve the mochi cut into small pieces――
Make sure to let the kitchen know."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Customer
text_block_list.text:
Excuuuse me.
Could you tell me about the health benefits of this onsen...?
choice_data_list: Yes, um, as for that one……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The whirlwind busyness continued well into the night――

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're good for today.
Head back to your room and get some rest, dear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I might have underestimated
how busy an inn gets during New Year's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how much help was I really able to provide...?
As I spent time in my room pondering this—
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank goodness, you're still awake.
choice_data_list: What in the world are the two of you doing...?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Oh, come on! Isn't it obvious?♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
On the night after surviving an absolute ordeal,
there is only one thing left for everyone to do――

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: It's time for the after-party~♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Here, don't be shy, eat up.
Though it's just staff meal food, mind you.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Still, it is quite delicious, you know?
Our chef never cuts corners, even when preparing staff meals♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
P-l-u-s...
They even took my request: 'Season it so it pairs nicely with drinks for our after-party♪'

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Honestly, this girl... She never misses a beat, does she.
choice_data_list: Um, are you sure that's alright...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All I helped with were the simplest of chores.
To think I contributed enough to join the landlady
and young mistress's wrap-up party――

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...A simple job? That sounds perfectly fine to me.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: The finest hospitality, you see, is built upon a foundation of countless "simple tasks."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Because you took care of that today,
we were able to focus on our own work.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
If we aren't comrades worth treating,
then what on earth are we?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Come now, Trainer, let us make a toast together♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, sheer bliss, sheer bliss♪
A drink after working hard tastes so good.
Don't you agree, Trainer-sama?♪
choice_data_list: The young proprietress... sure is strong...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Hoshina-san, have a drink with us too♪
It's our after-party, after all~? Come on, come on~♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Oh, my!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is super rare!
Takeshi-san actually having a drink with someone in public!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...What? I just figured having a drink with "comrades"
over New Year's wouldn't be half bad, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the bustling banquet night
flowed by, shared among the three of them――
